## Preview UI & Typst navigation

- **Preview stays responsive**: PDF page SVG conversion runs off the GPUI UI thread; Typst live preview sheets are rasterized to PNG on the compiler thread. Title-bar layout / side-bar buttons remain clickable while preview is open or compiling.
- **Typst jump feedback**: Preview click → source scrolls into view, flashes the target line, focuses the editor, and leaves preview-only layout when needed. Toast confirms the jump.
- **Go to Definition (F12)**: First slice for same-file Typst labels/refs via typst-ide `definition`.
- **Logging**: Leveled timing around Typst compile, PDF page conversion, and title-bar layout handlers (`RUST_LOG=malgel=info,...`).
